name: Goldtooth
summary: Goldtooth is an Elwynn Forest quest that concludes the feud-sparking search for Auntie Bernice Stonefield's missing heirloom. After young Billy Maclure confesses where the necklace ended up, you must track down a thieving kobold lurking in the Fargodeep Mine.

sections.title: A Boy's Mischief
sections.body: The search for Auntie Bernice Stonefield's lost family necklace begins as a sour border dispute between the feuding Stonefield and Maclure families. Bernice naturally suspected the rival family had taken it, but the culprit turns out to be Billy Maclure. While horsing around near the Fargodeep Mine, the young rascal ended up losing the trinket, hastily covering up his guilt by claiming he merely stumbled upon it before a creature snatched it away.

sections.title: The Den Above the Mine
sections.body: According to Billy, an unusually large, gleaming-fanged kobold scooped up the shiny keepsake and scurried off. Billy claims it ran back to a den above the mine, but the beast, named Goldtooth, actually lurks on the lower level of the Fargodeep Mine itself. Slaying the creature recovers Bernice's necklace, ending the neighborhood dispute and earning an old campaign keepsake left behind by Bernice's late husband.

faq.answer: Billy Maclure took it while messing around, though he claims he merely found and dropped it near the Fargodeep Mine. Before he could retrieve it, the kobold Goldtooth grabbed the shiny prize.
Goldtooth lurks within the Fargodeep Mine itself, on its lower level, rather than in the den above the mine that Billy describes.

faq.q: What kind of creature is Goldtooth?
faq.answer: Goldtooth is an oversized kobold notable for the gleaming golden fang that earned him his moniker, drawn like all his kin to bright, shiny trinkets.

faq.q: How does this quest tie into the Maclure and Stonefield feud?
faq.answer: The Stonefields and Maclures are bitter rivals who suspect each other of any petty theft or misfortune. Auntie Bernice assumed the Maclures stole her necklace out of spite, though tracking it down reveals it was simply Billy's carelessness.

faq.q: What is the reward from Auntie Bernice?
faq.answer: Auntie Bernice gives you an old, supposedly lucky keepsake that belonged to her late husband, who tragically forgot to take it along on his final military campaign.

faq.q: What quest leads directly into Goldtooth?
faq.answer: The quest Back to Billy leads directly into Goldtooth, where you bribe Billy Maclure with pork so he will finally confess what happened to the necklace.

angles.text: Resolving this squabble helps smooth over local friction between two of Elwynn's oldest farming families, while dealing with the persistent kobold vermin that plague the realm.
